name: jmap-mail
description: Read, search, and safely organize mail over JMAP providers such as Fastmail.

config.label: JMAP session URL
config.description: Provider JMAP session resource. Fastmail: https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session

config.label: JMAP API token
config.description: Bearer token for JMAP. Fastmail: Settings → Privacy & Security → Manage API tokens. Stored plaintext in user config; treat as a credential.

config.label: Default account id or name
config.description: Optional JMAP account id or account name/email. Empty: use the provider's primary mail account.

config.label: Max body bytes per email
config.description: Upper bound on body text fetched per message (capped at 1,000,000). Tool calls may request less, never more.

config.label: Enable sieve filter tools
config.description: Offer the email_sieve_* tools: a local, versioned store for managing sieve mail filters (with the sieve-rules skill). Off by default; local-only either way.

config.label: Write an audit log
config.description: Append a record of every email_* tool call — what was asked, what changed, when, and under which access level — to audit-YYYY-MM-DD.NNN.jsonl in the extension's data directory. Never records message subjects, senders, or bodies; only email_destroy records per-message ids, since that operation cannot be undone. On by default: this extension changes a mailbox on the model's initiative, and a few hundred bytes per call is a cheap record of what it did. email_status shows whether it is active and where it is writing.

config.label: Audit log retention (days)
config.description: Delete audit files older than this many days. 0 keeps them forever — right for a deployment that ships them off-host, wrong for a laptop. Ignored when audit_log is off.

config.label: Compress rotated audit files
config.description: gzip each audit file once it stops being written to; JSON Lines compresses to roughly a tenth. The current day's file stays uncompressed so a log collector can tail it. Turn off if whatever reads these files cannot handle .gz.

config.label: Access level
config.description: read-only: search/fetch only. read-organize: adds mark/move/trash. read-organize-destroy: adds permanent destroy. Tools above the level are withdrawn from the model. The local sieve tools follow enable_sieve_tools instead.
